message:
Stiffening out of the walking band is disproportionate for this 40 m span, Structural Dynamicist, so pure added damping governs over added steel. In plain words the low-tune spring sags more than it shakes, and that sag sizes the under-deck space. The static sag is 74.7 mm from the static-sag calculation (E63), larger than the 49.4 mm dynamic stroke in the free-decay simulation (E17), so the total envelope is about 125 mm or a hand width and still fits inside girder depth; the stop contact at 80 mm compression is 8.40 kN from the stop-force calculation (E66) on top of 13.1 kN combined static plus dynamic load from the combined-load calculation (E65), while total Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), weight 7.85 kN from the static-weight calculation (E26) against 600 kN live load from the live-load estimate (E30) is 1.31 percent and meets the 2 percent rule.

Friction grip without welds or drilling is the buildable load path for that cycling load, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead. In plain words one preloaded bolt can hold the device in slip but several are needed to survive loosening at 1.9 Hz. I take from the 1 Experiments on coldformed steel momentresisting connections with 2 bolting frictionslip mechanism (E57) that slip capacity is calculated per EN 1993-1-8 assuming friction coefficient 0.3, which gives 32.9 kN design slip resistance per bolt from the slip-resistance calculation (E64) against 13.1 kN demand from the combined-load calculation (E65), so four bolts give redundancy; I take from the (PDF) Loss of preload in pretensioned bolts (E58) that preload loss must be checked, which confirms the fatigue concern in the Load-deformation behavior of injection bolts for maintenance of steel structures under dynamic loads (E24); this maps directly onto the seismic pipe-clamp friction attachment because I take from the Seismic Pipe Hanger: Secure & Reliable Support (E61) that friction-holding devices enable weld-free attachment and non-welded connections cut installation time, and from the UL CE Certified U Shaped Pipe Clamp with Quick Lateral Bracing Universal Hanger System (E62) that double U-bolts with lock nuts make a rigid connection resisting impact loads.

Acceptance needs a separate measured verdict, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, and I confirm the Millennium Bridge, London (E39) precedent that silhouette is kept by working below deck. In plain words the lift industry measures ride the same way the bridge must prove comfort. I take from the Chapter 15 PDF (E60) that draft ISO 18738 Measurement of Lift Ride Quality establishes requirements, methodology and processing for acceleration evaluation but does not try to establish what is or is not acceptable, and from the a P000498 (E59) that ISO 18738 ride measurement needs a defined sensor contact pressure with a mandatory measuring plate, which maps onto a crowd walk-through logging vertical acceleration over time with the comfort band setting pass or fail, holding Medium 0.5 to 1.0 m/s2 against 0.67 m/s2 retrofitted from the retrofitted-acceleration calculation (E44) versus 8.28 m/s2 bare at 0.844 g from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43). My position is not ready, because clamp preload maintenance, stop impact into the cross-beam, and the Manager comfort choice are still open.
